mission: Provide one owner control that runs the broadest safe repository verification, recovery, benchmarks, business/revenue asset generation, repo-wide connection audit, anti-stagnation gap velocity, sandbox, ontology, workforce, runtime, speed, accuracy and certification systems and records every failure for repair.
maximum_steps: per-bot business blueprints and Revenue OS inheritance
benchmark stagnation/velocity audit and closure estimate

always_on_model.meaning: durable supervised recurring execution rather than one immortal process

benchmark_gap_rule: Every generated benchmark case is scanned into the parallel benchmark gap registry and receives accountable benchmark, builder, integration, QA, security/compliance, performance, business-value and release-review lanes. Independent canonical owners should be worked concurrently up to safe configured limits.
no_stagnant_benchmark_rule: Open benchmark gaps must keep producing measurement, assignment, repair or retest evidence within config/benchmark-gap-acceleration-policy.json thresholds. Stagnant gaps are escalated; they are never silently hidden or auto-passed.
revenue_os_rule: Every canonical sellable bot receives the Bot Blueprint and reusable Revenue OS business assets, but live outreach, spend, contracts and payments remain permission/approval gated and revenue claims require verified events.
government_rule: Government benchmarks must improve usability, productivity, transparency and service quality one department/service/job/task at a time, preserve jurisdiction-specific authority, and require authoritative current sources for programs, forms, fees, eligibility, spending, debt, grants and contracts. Government spending, grants and procurement notices are evidence signals that require fit analysis, not guaranteed revenue.
max_sandbox_rule: Every bot capability, discovered tool/function, generated worker, API, resource, job task, business workflow and deployment path maps to all applicable sandbox categories including negative, property/metamorphic/fuzz, adversarial, security, permission, privacy, recovery, fault/chaos, load, migration, compatibility, accessibility, speed, accuracy, cost, observability and rollback overlays.
live_user_gate: Run Everything Now may certify readiness for controlled live-user testing only when release blockers are zero, core production verification passes, required sandbox coverage has runtime evidence, high-risk actions remain approval gated, and observability/rollback are ready.
truth_rule: Running everything creates evidence; it does not make failing or untested systems pass. Always-on operation means supervised recurring/restartable execution with explicit cost and safety controls.
